summary: Butte's Democratic city convention opens at 12:30 at the Auditorium, with Jerry Clifford, chairman of the democratic city central committee, calling order alongside Secretary Naughton. Harris is defeated by McArthur for temporary chairman, and the Daly faction holds a working majority throughout. The platform, described as harmless, denounces the high tariff, praises silver re-coinage, and condemns the Republican gold-bug administration; Patrick J. Murphy appears among the Ward 1 delegates, though the full ward-by-ward delegate rolls remain OCR-degraded. [transcription partial — body and delegate lists not verified against fullpage.jpg]
key_quotes: Jerry Clifford, chairman of the democratic city central committee, who occupied a chair on the Auditorium stage with Secretary Naughton, hammered on the table for order
